axes.name: Original obligations and explicit constraints
axes.reasoning: All original needs remain: twelve Android inspectors, day-long offline forms/photos/location, coordinator corrections, simple operations, portable export/migration, accessible forms, selective sharing and possible future self-hosting. O1 has useful distinct approaches; O2 has mechanism/default/applicability research; O3 has documented issue/fix and evolution chains; O4 covers all P clauses; O5 is one coherent prose final; O6 gives discriminating unexecuted tests. Unknown device fleet, photo volume, operator capacity and organizational policies are explicitly left to decision/measurement rather than used to evade available source research. The brief did not require a deployed app, procurement winner, compliance certification or an unlimited production guarantee.

axes.name: Consequential facts, defaults, units and applicability
axes.reasoning: Independent primary review supports WorkManager periodic/backoff units, Room migrations, CameraX asynchronous completion, Android persistence/uninstall and location units; PowerSync SQLite/filter/upload/backend example/maturity/license/release distinctions; CouchDB branches, member read scope, selectors and released attachment fix; ODK version-precondition/whole-XML/media/review/export/hosting specifics; Kobo offline states/USB; QFieldCloud timestamps/manual and GeoPackage; Mergin offline/selective files; Survey parent/repeat/Inbox/photo boundaries; Fulcrum Downloader-scoped cap; PostgreSQL single-DB export; and web storage/WCAG units and exceptions. Proposed architecture is marked as inference/design. No consequential factual defect remains. Historical q1 'latest' is not promoted to a maintained-version recommendation. The ODK benchmark omits its original 2018 configuration in final prose but is expressly bounded/vendor-authored and never extrapolated; this is a limit, not a material performance overclaim. HTTP 409 is explicitly ODK-specific, not a PowerSync response rule.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery and retained alternatives
axes.reasoning: Custom Room/API outbox, PowerSync relational partial sync, CouchDB document replication, ODK/Kobo form-first capture, QField/Mergin GIS-first work, Survey123 existing-Esri fit and Fulcrum export benchmark are materially different beyond the thin PWA/LWW plan. They offer useful discriminators: map versus list tasks, one editor versus collaboration, preloaded forms, source-database versus replication models, file availability, operator effort and exit portability. All survive in final prose with conditions. The candidate does not claim all leads already cover the nonprofit's end-to-end correction workflow or that an export-only Fulcrum page proves offline/self-host fit. Price, organizational licensing suitability and hands-on fit are honest unresolved adoption work.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation
axes.reasoning: All eleven proposals were examined for trigger, expected behavior, independent comparison/oracle and release applicability. They discriminate real failure classes: kill/reboot durability, low-space/partial media, replay/acknowledgement, same-base races in both orders, scope tampering/revocation, corrupt export/clean restore, schema evolution, accessible offline interaction and coordinator task flow. Alternative-specific tests name relevant mechanisms/releases. They are honestly proposed, with organizational quantitative thresholds pending. Executed work is primary-source inspection only; no app/device/server/user witness or successful runtime test is claimed. Our released-code inspection likewise supplies source corroboration only. Candidate native lifecycle statements are not an experimental reliability result and are not independently authenticated here.

candidate.passage: Correct the persistence recommendation; leave client choice uncertain and to the user.

Final retains that PWA path, quota/persistence/recovery tests and a user choice; it therefore does not falsely reject browser persistence or the PWA. plan_adjudication.exact: Upload complete inspection JSON on reconnect with last-write-wins.

candidate.passage: Split: a versioned full first submission may be an option; reject silent/general LWW and correct update/replay behavior.

plan_adjudication.reasoning: A full new submission is retained if stable IDs and idempotence protect retries. For corrections, a stale whole-record snapshot and silent LWW can erase meaningful evidence. Final preserves user ownership/conflict choices and both disputed values. ODK's current-version precondition/409/XML replacement is explicitly an example; PowerSync's backend guidance and QFieldCloud timestamps are distinct; CouchDB branch preservation does not solve semantic correctness.

plan_adjudication.exact: Store photo URLs in each form.

candidate.passage: Reject a URL as the complete photo design; use stable attachment identity and an offline media path.

plan_adjudication.reasoning: An online URL alone does not store captured offline bytes or prove upload/authorization. Stable media/parent IDs, durable files, separate transfer state and a portable join address the brief. Final retains a URL as a post-upload locator and leaves gallery/retention/EXIF decisions open, so it does not reject a valid URL-plus-file implementation.

candidate.passage: Already covered by the brief; retain and specify the workflow and export.

plan_adjudication.reasoning: The original coordinator correction review and portable migration requirements remain. Reviewer reasons/history, media-completeness state, explicit return path, IDs/dictionary/units/files/manifest elaborate the requirement. Neither a CSV alone nor pg_dump includes separately stored original photos or establishes migration. GeoJSON/GeoPackage and export scope remain optional/product decisions, not new mandatory features.

plan_adjudication.exact: Defer access control beyond individual sign-in until rollout.

candidate.passage: Reject deferral if sharing is enabled; add minimum server authorization before any pilot that exposes shared records.

plan_adjudication.reasoning: Selective sharing is an original research requirement, but the brief does not fix a day-one permission matrix or partner workflow. Final narrows the earlier q1 unconditional first-release language: scope must be enforced before records/media are shared, or the undefined path stays disabled. Auth-derived sync filters do not protect upload/file endpoints; CouchDB members can directly read the whole DB. No unlimited security guarantee is asserted.

candidate.passage: Retain as a connectivity smoke check; correct it as insufficient release validation.

Final retains it as item 11 and labels every expanded scenario proposed. It does not say the smoke check is useless or claim those scenarios were run.

validation_review.name: 24-hour offline durability
validation_review.oracle: Acknowledged local answers/media and truthful queue survive force-close/reboot.
validation_review.discrimination: Discriminates network-independent durable storage from mere transient cache.

validation_review.name: Photo integrity/capacity
validation_review.oracle: Interrupted capture/upload and low storage yield intact originals or explicit recoverable failures, verified hashes and no silent unsynced cleanup.
validation_review.discrimination: Camera callback and durable file/media-state boundaries have independent byte/hash and expected-file oracles.

validation_review.name: Replay/acknowledgement
validation_review.oracle: Repeated event IDs produce one logical server event; expected file hashes and actual acknowledgements match.
validation_review.discrimination: An independent server ledger/expected event set can detect lost acknowledgements and duplicates; not a zero-exit-only test.

validation_review.name: Conflicts and correction handoff
validation_review.oracle: Same-base/same-field edits in both reconnect orders preserve both values and correction history under chosen policy.
validation_review.discrimination: Adversarial ordering and distinct-field control discriminate silent overwrite from intended conflict behavior.

validation_review.name: Scope/revocation
validation_review.oracle: Altered IDs/parameters, direct calls, guessed files and revoked reuse cannot grant new out-of-scope access.
validation_review.discrimination: Two separate assignments supply the independent expected permissions; offline cached copies are an explicit limitation.

validation_review.name: Export/import/restore
validation_review.oracle: Independent clean destination retains every expected join/hash/history; corrupt bundles reject without partial replacement.
validation_review.discrimination: Expected manifest and pristine source dataset are the oracle; a CSV success or successful command exit alone is insufficient.

validation_review.name: Schema/form evolution
validation_review.oracle: Drafts and queued events keep values and historic interpretation across adds/renames/removals.
validation_review.discrimination: Known pre-upgrade datasets allow independent expected-value checks, beyond migration returning success.

validation_review.name: Accessibility offline flow
validation_review.oracle: TalkBack traversal/announcements, large text, errors, permission denial, recovery and correction work on actual devices/web.
validation_review.discrimination: Observed accessibility/task behavior and standards units are the oracle, not automated Scanner alone.

validation_review.name: Coordinator usability
validation_review.oracle: Coordinator identifies missing evidence, returns the intended case/reason, sees corrected version and exports the selected set.
validation_review.discrimination: Scripted mixed queue and known expected tasks discriminate misleading states; numerical thresholds require agreement.

validation_review.name: Alternative-specific releases/workflows
validation_review.oracle: PowerSync auth/checkpoint/upgrade, CouchDB exact source/attachment version, Survey existing-image Inbox/offline edit, and ODK/Kobo correction/export are exercised on pinned targets.
validation_review.discrimination: Named mechanisms and release-specific triggers avoid generalizing one vendor's defaults; released CouchDB fix is source evidence rather than a runtime pass.

validation_review.name: Connectivity smoke check
validation_review.oracle: Connectivity/reconnect indicator and elementary transfer can be observed.
validation_review.discrimination: Retained as one narrow check; cannot replace the preceding failure-class oracles.
